question: Which of the following is NOT a salient feature of liberalisation ?

options.text: Selling part of equity shares of public sector undertakings to public
De - reservation of goods for small scale industry

solution:
The correct answer is __**Selling part of equity shares of public sector undertakings to public**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Selling part of equity shares of public sector undertakings to public**:

 
 
• This is a feature of **privatisation**, not liberalisation.
 
• Privatisation involves transferring ownership or control from the public sector to the private sector.
 
 
 
• **Examples**:
 
• Selling stakes in companies like Bharat Petroleum, LIC, or Air India.
 
• It allows private shareholders to own a part of these enterprises.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Liberalization is the process of reducing or removing government **restrictions on economic activity. 
 
• It is often used in the context of economic reforms, such as the 1991 economic reforms in India. 
 
• Some features of liberalization include:
 
 
• **Abolishing industrial licensing **
 
• **Lowering interest rates and tariffs **
 
• **Removing the public sector's monopoly in certain areas of the economy **
 
• **Disinvesting in public sector enterprises **
 
• **Privatizing public sector enterprises **
